conditions.rightValue: Subject: New submission for your "General Masterclass" form

options.systemMessage:
You are a strict validator. Output ONLY valid JSON. No prose, no markdown.

Input is a JSON array of objects { "q": string, "a": string }.

For each item:
- Let s = a trimmed and lowercased.
- FAIL reason "banned_word" if s is exactly one of:
  yes, no, maybe, i don't know, idk, n/a, na, none, -
- Else FAIL reason "too_short" if a has fewer than 12 characters.
- Else FAIL reason "too_few_words" if a has fewer than 3 words (split on whitespace).
- Otherwise PASS.

Return exactly this JSON shape:
{
  "fails":[{"question":string,"answer":string,"reason":"banned_word"|"too_short"|"too_few_words"}],
  "passCount": number,
  "failCount": number
}

Rules:
- passCount + failCount must equal the number of input items.
- If input is empty, return:
  {"fails":[],"passCount":0,"failCount":0}
- Use the original question text in "question".
- Use the original answer text in "answer".
- Output ONLY JSON.

Hi {{ $node["Set Gmail & Fillout Fields"].json["firstName"] || 'there' }},

During the call, Oliver will share insights about his experience working with us. Please feel free to ask him any questions you may have about the internship, the projects, or what it is like to work at FloLabs.

Important Note:

By attending this interview, you agree to follow up with us afterward, regardless of whether you decide to continue in the process.

To schedule your call, please choose the time that is most convenient for you using the link below:

Schedule Your Call with Oliver

If none of the available times work for you, please reply to this email with your availability and keep Oliver.Abreu@FloLabsRD.com in CC so he can help coordinate a suitable time.

We look forward to hearing from you and learning more about you in this next step.

Best regards,
Paula
FloLabs
